blocks.text: Sage Health Centre takes a personalized approach to addiction treatment, recognizing that each person’s journey towards recovery is unique. Their programs blend traditional 12-Step/SMART philosophy with holistic wellness modalities to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses both physical and mental health. This approach allows clients to not only overcome addiction, but also improve their overall well-being.

blocks.text: The residential program at Sage Health Centre focuses on stabilization and early recovery, providing clients with a safe and supportive environment. centre.name: Sage Health Centre
centre.about_html:
Sage Health Centre takes a personalized approach to addiction treatment, recognizing that each person’s journey towards recovery is unique. Their programs blend traditional 12-Step/SMART philosophy with holistic wellness modalities to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses both physical and mental health. This approach allows clients to not only overcome addiction, but also improve their overall well-being.

 

The residential program at Sage Health Centre focuses on stabilization and early recovery, providing clients with a safe and supportive environment. Clients have access to unlimited individual counseling sessions, ensuring that they receive the one-on-one attention they need to process core issues and current concerns. Additionally, clients participate in co-ed and gender-specific groups covering topics such as relapse prevention, personal limits and codependency, and stress management techniques.

 

Sage Health Centre’s approach is centered around empowering clients to take responsibility for their own recovery. The programs provide tools and resources to help clients build the skills necessary to maintain sobriety and live a healthy life after leaving the centre.

The Benefits of Residential Treatment at Sage Health Centre

Residential treatment provides a unique opportunity for individuals struggling with addiction to receive intensive support in a structured environment. Sage Health Centre’s residential program offers a range of benefits to clients who choose this option.

 

First and foremost, the residential program at Sage Health Centre provides clients with a supportive and safe environment to focus on their recovery. The comfortable and home-like facility allows clients to relax and fully engage in the treatment process.

 

In addition, the program offers individualized care and attention. Clients have access to unlimited individual counseling sessions, which are tailored to their specific needs in order to process core issues and current concerns. Groups are also offered to clients to help establish camaraderie and peer support.

 

Finally, the program at Sage Health Centre guides clients every step of the way, from start to finish. The comprehensive treatment plan provides clients with the tools and resources necessary to achieve and maintain sobriety, and the centre also offers virtual support for family members during the treatment process.



Sage Health Centre- Center Overview

Sage Health Centre is a highly reputable rehab center that provides exceptional care and support to adults battling with addiction. Offering a range of 28-84 days of treatment, the facility promises a customized treatment program that is designed to suit each client’s unique needs. Sage Health Centre is committed to providing a safe, healthy, and welcoming environment for its clients and staff, and the team works in partnership with various health authorities and regulatory bodies to ensure that the center operates within the latest guidelines and industry standards. Through evidence-based treatment programs, Sage Health Centre offers hope, healing, and a path towards recovery, helping clients get back on the road to a healthy and fulfilling life.

Nestled on secluded private property in Kamloops, BC, Sage Health Centre offers an idyllic setting that promotes a healthy and respectful balance between residents and programming. The co-ed residential treatment center is licensed and abstinence-based, offering an essential service to clients, families, employers, and referral agents seeking help with addictions. With gender-specific residences and programming, clients can find the right environment and support to achieve their recovery goals under the guidance of experienced, compassionate staff members who are committed to client success. Whether you’re looking for addiction treatment for yourself or someone close to you, Sage Health Centre provides a safe, caring, and supportive space where you can get the help and guidance you need to overcome addiction and reclaim your life.

Frequently Asked Questions About Sage Health Centre

What is residential addiction treatment?

Residential addiction treatment is a program where clients temporarily reside at the treatment centre for an extended period of time to receive intensive support.

Do you have to stay at the treatment centre during the whole program?

Yes, clients in the residential program at Sage Health Centre will reside at the facility for the duration of the program.

How long does the program last?

The length of the program varies depending on the individual’s needs, but typically lasts 30-90 days.

What kind of addictions does Sage Health Centre treat?

Sage Health Centre offers addiction treatment for a variety of substances, including alcohol, drugs, and prescription medication.

What is the cost of the program?

The cost of the program varies depending on the length and level of care needed. Contact Sage Health Centre directly for more information.

raw_html:
Sage Health Centre takes a personalized approach to addiction treatment, recognizing that each person’s journey towards recovery is unique. Their programs blend traditional 12-Step/SMART philosophy with holistic wellness modalities to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses both physical and mental health. This approach allows clients to not only overcome addiction, but also improve their overall well-being.

 

The residential program at Sage Health Centre focuses on stabilization and early recovery, providing clients with a safe and supportive environment. Clients have access to unlimited individual counseling sessions, ensuring that they receive the one-on-one attention they need to process core issues and current concerns. Additionally, clients participate in co-ed and gender-specific groups covering topics such as relapse prevention, personal limits and codependency, and stress management techniques.

 

Sage Health Centre’s approach is centered around empowering clients to take responsibility for their own recovery. The programs provide tools and resources to help clients build the skills necessary to maintain sobriety and live a healthy life after leaving the centre.

The Benefits of Residential Treatment at Sage Health Centre

Residential treatment provides a unique opportunity for individuals struggling with addiction to receive intensive support in a structured environment. Sage Health Centre’s residential program offers a range of benefits to clients who choose this option.

 

First and foremost, the residential program at Sage Health Centre provides clients with a supportive and safe environment to focus on their recovery. The comfortable and home-like facility allows clients to relax and fully engage in the treatment process.

 

In addition, the program offers individualized care and attention. Clients have access to unlimited individual counseling sessions, which are tailored to their specific needs in order to process core issues and current concerns. Groups are also offered to clients to help establish camaraderie and peer support.

 

Finally, the program at Sage Health Centre guides clients every step of the way, from start to finish. The comprehensive treatment plan provides clients with the tools and resources necessary to achieve and maintain sobriety, and the centre also offers virtual support for family members during the treatment process.



Sage Health Centre- Center Overview

Sage Health Centre is a highly reputable rehab center that provides exceptional care and support to adults battling with addiction. Offering a range of 28-84 days of treatment, the facility promises a customized treatment program that is designed to suit each client’s unique needs. Sage Health Centre is committed to providing a safe, healthy, and welcoming environment for its clients and staff, and the team works in partnership with various health authorities and regulatory bodies to ensure that the center operates within the latest guidelines and industry standards. Through evidence-based treatment programs, Sage Health Centre offers hope, healing, and a path towards recovery, helping clients get back on the road to a healthy and fulfilling life.

Nestled on secluded private property in Kamloops, BC, Sage Health Centre offers an idyllic setting that promotes a healthy and respectful balance between residents and programming. The co-ed residential treatment center is licensed and abstinence-based, offering an essential service to clients, families, employers, and referral agents seeking help with addictions. With gender-specific residences and programming, clients can find the right environment and support to achieve their recovery goals under the guidance of experienced, compassionate staff members who are committed to client success. Whether you’re looking for addiction treatment for yourself or someone close to you, Sage Health Centre provides a safe, caring, and supportive space where you can get the help and guidance you need to overcome addiction and reclaim your life.
